comment: Solo live CTF leave-drop route on Sector 9. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=ctf FRAGR_QA_MAP=4 FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_SEED=42.

states.name: ctf_solo_join
states.note: The client joins a live Sector 9 CTF round before taking the enemy flag.

states.name: ctf_enemy_stand
states.note: The client crosses Mid Doors and takes the live Union flag as a Coalition fighter.

states.name: ctf_leave_drop
states.note: The Coalition carrier explicitly leaves. The server drops the Union flag at the last carried position, with a live return timer.

states.name: ctf_auto_return
states.note: The server returns the dropped Union flag to its stand after the 20-second clock.
